A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Before you
make a start.

Is this a physical product?

No. The Wedding Clarity Kit is planned as a digital PDF guide and Google Sheets workbook, with supporting digital resources. Nothing will be shipped.

Do I need a paid Google account?

A free personal Google account supports creating and editing Google Sheets files. The final workbook still needs to be tested with a free account before launch to confirm that it requires no paid features or add-ons.

Can I use it if my wedding is only a few months away?

The kit is intended to help organize the decisions you still need to make, even if planning is already underway. Start with your existing commitments, payments, and remaining tasks. It cannot guarantee vendor availability or that every task will fit your timeline.

Can my partner use the workbook with me?

Google Sheets lets you share your own copy with your partner and grant editing access. Final sharing instructions and the kit’s usage terms must be confirmed before launch.

Does the kit book vendors or plan the event for us?

No. You and your partner make the decisions and contact vendors yourselves. The kit does not book vendors, automatically calculate local prices, or replace a wedding planner or coordinator.

How do I receive the files?

Pending setup: the delivery platform and access instructions have not been provided. Confirm and describe the real delivery process here before accepting purchases. Instant access is not currently promised.

What is the actual support and refund policy?

Pending setup: support contact details, support availability, and the applicable refund policy have not been provided. These must be added and linked before launch. No refund guarantee or response time is currently offered on this preview.
